sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 2048 Legend is a tile-matching puzzle game where players aim to combine tiles with numbers to get to the magical 2048 tile. The game starts with four tiles on the board, each with a value of 2. Players can slide tiles left, right, up, or down to combine adjacent tiles with the same value. When two tiles with the same value collide, they merge into a single tile with a value that is the sum of the two tiles. The game ends when there are no more moves left, and the player's score is calculated based on the highest tile value reached.

The game's core mechanics are simple yet challenging. Players need to strategically plan their moves to create new tiles with the highest value. The game's grid design allows for various combinations, making each game unique. Players can use the undo feature to correct their moves and try again.

One of the unique features of 2048 Legend is the addition of power-ups. Players can earn power-ups by completing levels or achieving specific milestones. Power-ups can be used to swap two tiles, move a tile to a specific position, or remove a tile. Power-ups add a new layer of strategy to the game, making it more engaging and challenging.
